issues.what: Block 4 shot 2 (Frau Troffea at the well, 00:29.0-00:33.2): impossible physics at 00:30.8-00:31.4. She stands in front of the well wall at 00:30.4, then in 0.6 s her head drops about 0.6 head-heights while her legs and skirt vanish behind/into the solid well wall; at 00:31.3 only her torso shows above the rim, then she is 'seated' inside the ring of dancers. No sit-down is visible. (Moderate confidence: could be read as a fast sit behind the wall, but a camera could not have filmed a body sinking into stone.)

fix.repair: Cut the 0.8 s span 00:30.8-00:31.6 (block-4 clip offset about 5.4-6.2 s) as a jump cut from standing to seated; the earlier 1.8 s and the later 1.6 s are clean. Set shot clip_len 4.4 -> 3.6 and let the block end 0.8 s earlier, or hold the last frame of the previous kneeling shot 0.8 s. No new media, no credits. Fallback if the jump looks bad: regen block 4 clip (8 s).

Voice and on-screen captions (00:00-00:02): 'The first woman could not stop dancing' (whisper probabilities 0.79-0.99). Captions follow the voice, so they also differ from the script.

Alternative at zero cost: change script hook, block text and captions to 'The first woman' (true: Frau Troffea began it) and keep the audio, but the 00:14 error below still needs the re-voice, so re-voice once for both.
